notes: *also* is the waw's under rule 51, postposed after the fronted subject; marking it added is excluded because a waw stands in the clause.
*goeth down* keeps its particle with בּוֹא under rule 44, the bare verb not writing the setting of the sun.
שָׁם takes the relative *where*: no relative morpheme stands in the clause, and rule 22 heads such a fusion on whatever resumptive morpheme is written. The explicit הוּא keeps its own *it*.
